result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but the 'Popular right now' card for Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows a broken/missing image placeholder instead of a restaurant photo, which looks visually broken. Other elements (header, search, chips, promo banner, 'Fastest near you' carousel, bottom nav) render correctly; the partially visible carousel item at the right edge and the card cut off at the bottom viewport edge are expected behaviors and not reported.

issues.description: The main image of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card in the 'Popular right now' section fails to load and displays a gray placeholder box with a broken-image icon, while other restaurant cards show proper imagery.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source/URL for this restaurant card or provide a fallback image so a real photo renders instead of the broken-image placeholder.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button on the broken-image card sits on a plain gray placeholder, making the circular gray button blend into the background with low visual separation.
issues.suggestion: Once the image loads correctly the contrast will resolve; otherwise ensure the heart button has sufficient contrast against any placeholder background.
